source: Frozen project experiment artifacts, not a new run

protocol.timing_scope: prepared RGB to CPU RLE, FP32 batch 1, A40, score floor 0.001

bootstrap_yolo_true.scope: paired image resampling conditional on fixed checkpoints; no training variance

bootstrap_selected_ap.protocol: 2,000 paired image draws, seed 6129, percentile 95%; fixed checkpoints and validation-selected reconstruction; no training variance; exposed test set

bootstrap_calibrated_f1.protocol: paired image percentile bootstrap; fixed weights and validation cutoffs; test previously exposed

baseline.stage_protocol: per-GT coverage, not one-to-one recall; boxes use original COCO bbox; masks use original COCO RLE; score floor follows each config; absence at a stage is not exclusive causal attribution

reconstruction_selection.selection: maximum original-mask COCO validation AP50:95; exact ties prefer True

historical.scope: prepared RGB PIL to CPU RLE; disk decode excluded; FP32 batch 1; co-resident models; no diagnostic hooks

retrained.scope: prepared RGB PIL to CPU RLE; excludes disk decode; FP32 batch 1; co-resident models; CUDA synchronised

limitations: Earlier test-based selection of historical Mask R-CNN
Image bootstrap does not measure training or tuning variance
Pipeline timing is not model-forward timing

matched_mask.note: unmatched_predictions are extra detections with no same-class GT instance above iou_match_threshold. classify_error() has no dedicated false-positive category, so it is only applied to matched pairs and to missed GT instances; unmatched_predictions is reported separately instead of being forced into it.
Same greedy same-class matched-pair protocol as evaluation/mask_iou.py (the YOLO version), applied to the Mask R-CNN checkpoint, so both methods are directly comparable.
